title: BLD-693: ns-gm Server-Side Decomposition (CLI)
description: Tour of the CLI-side changes: two new subcommands (hlx inspect netsuite and hlx run) as thin HTTP interfaces to the server-side NetSuite proxy.

steps.title: cmdNetsuite Handler - SuiteQL + Logs
steps.description: 60-line handler with two modes: query mode (SuiteQL via --query or positional args) and logs mode (triggered by 'logs' positional arg with optional --script-id). Reads nsDefaultEnv from /tmp/helix-inspect/manifest.json for default --env.

steps.title: cmdRun Handler - Arbitrary SuiteScript
steps.description: 53-line handler for arbitrary SuiteScript execution. --repo is required (validated with exit(1)), --code from flag or positional args, --modules split on commas, --env with manifest fallback. POSTs to /api/inspect/{repoId}/run.

steps.title: Inspect Router - netsuite Case
steps.description: case 'netsuite' dispatches to cmdNetsuite(config, repo, rest). Includes help text for the netsuite subcommand with query and logs modes.

steps.title: Main Dispatcher - run Case
steps.description: case 'run' dispatches to cmdRun(config, args.slice(1)). Uses configOrHelp guard pattern consistent with other top-level commands.
